summary: Kennedy Lewis Capital Company filed a routine Form 8-K reporting September 23, 2026 events, disclosing August 31, 2026 net asset value per share of $19.44 for Class I and D and $19.42 for Class S, with aggregate NAV of $734.5 million and $1.266 billion portfolio fair value. It also updated its continuous public offering of up to $2.0 billion of shares and a private placement, totaling 33,633,739 shares and $677.6 million consideration. Exhibit 10.1 is a third amendment to its credit agreement; no special-situation transaction or shareholder action is present.
